# Data Source: identitynow_role

Use this data source to access information about an existing Role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_role" "example" {
  id = "2c91808a7813090a017813b6301f1234"
}

output "identitynow_role_name" {
  value = data.identitynow_role.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the role.

### Read-Only

- `access_profiles` (Attributes List) The access profiles assigned to this role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--access_profiles))
- `description` (String) The description of the role.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the role is enabled.
- `name` (String) The name of the role.
- `owner` (Attributes List) List with the owner of the role. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--owner))
- `requestable` (Boolean) Whether the role is requestable.

<a id="nestedatt--access_profiles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `access_profiles`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Access profile ID.
- `name` (String) Access profile name.
- `type` (String) Access profile type.


<a id="nestedatt--owner"></a>
### Nested Schema for `owner`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Owner ID.
- `name` (String) Owner name.
- `type` (String) Owner type.
